# Database / Object Storage

Git does not use a relational database. It implements its own content-addressable
object store on the filesystem, commonly called the **object database (ODB)**.

## Object Types

| Type | Header | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `blob` | `blob.h` | File content — raw bytes identified by SHA hash |
| `tree` | `tree.h` | Directory listing — maps filenames to blob/tree OIDs |
| `commit` | `commit.h` | Snapshot with parent links, tree pointer, author/committer metadata |
| `tag` | `tag.h` | Annotated tag pointing to any object |

All four types share a common `struct object` base (`object.h`) identified by
`struct object_id` (a SHA-1 or SHA-256 hash, `object-name.h`).

## Storage Layout

```
.git/
  objects/
    ab/cdef...   loose objects (2-char prefix dir / 38-char filename)
    pack/        packfiles (.pack + .idx pairs)
    info/        auxiliary info
  refs/          reference store (files or reftable)
  packed-refs    packed references file
```

## Refs Backends

| Backend | Location | Description |
|---------|----------|-------------|
| **files** | `refs/files-backend.c` | Classic loose-file refs under `.git/refs/` |
| **packed** | `refs/packed-backend.c` | `packed-refs` file for compacted refs |
| **reftable** | `refs/reftable-backend.c` + `reftable/` | Binary log-structured ref storage (newer) |

The ref backend is selected at repository initialisation time.

## Key Data Structures

| Struct | File | Purpose |
|--------|------|---------|
| `struct object_id` | `hash.h` / `object-name.h` | Hash value (SHA-1 20B or SHA-256 32B) |
| `struct commit` | `commit.h` | Commit object with parent list, tree OID |
| `struct tree` | `tree.h` | Tree object with entry list |
| `struct blob` | `blob.h` | Blob object (content loaded on demand) |
| `struct ref_store` | `refs-internal.h` | Polymorphic ref backend interface |
| `struct packed_git` | `pack.h` | In-memory packfile descriptor |
| `struct object_database` [?] | `odb.h` | Object store abstraction |

## Packfiles

Packfiles (`.pack`) are binary delta-compressed bundles of objects with
an index file (`.idx`) for O(log n) lookup. Multi-pack index (`midx`) allows
a single index over multiple packfiles.

## Migrations / Versioning

- No migration framework — storage format evolves via feature flags in `.git/config`
  (e.g. `extensions.objectFormat = sha256` for SHA-256 repositories)
- Reftable adoption is gated by `extensions.refStorage = reftable`
